name: Norway
genZNote: Norway turned North Sea oil money into the world's largest sovereign wealth fund — worth well over a trillion dollars — and still consistently ranks among the happiest countries on Earth, which is a genuinely rare combo of 'resource-rich' and 'well-governed.'

sections.heading: 🗺️ Geography
bullets: Occupies the western part of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, famous for its dramatic fjords carved by ancient glaciers.
Has an extremely long, deeply indented coastline and includes Arctic territories, experiencing the midnight sun in summer and polar night in winter in its northern regions.
Sparsely populated relative to its area, with most people living along the southern coast, including the capital Oslo.

sections.heading: 🗣️ People & Culture
bullets: Norwegian is the official language; the culture reflects a strong connection to nature, outdoor activities ('friluftsliv'), and Viking-era historical heritage.
Known for a strong social-democratic tradition and consistently ranks among the world's happiest and most gender-equal countries.
Traditional Sami indigenous culture is present in the northern regions, with recognised indigenous rights and cultural institutions.

sections.heading: 🏛️ Government & Society
bullets: A parliamentary constitutional monarchy; the King is a ceremonial head of state, while an elected Prime Minister and the Storting (parliament) govern.
Chose not to join the European Union in two separate referendums (1972 and 1994), though it participates in the EU single market through the European Economic Area (EEA).
Manages its vast oil wealth through the Government Pension Fund Global (its sovereign wealth fund), one of the largest in the world, designed to benefit future generations.

sections.heading: 🧬 Medical & Scientific Developments
bullets: A global leader in hydropower and, increasingly, offshore wind and other renewable energy technologies, despite its wealth being built on oil and gas.
Advanced maritime and offshore engineering expertise, developed initially for North Sea oil extraction and now applied to green shipping technology.
Strong public health outcomes supported by a well-funded universal healthcare system funded substantially by oil revenues.

sections.heading: 🌐 Global Relations
bullets: A NATO founding member (1949) but not an EU member, participating in the EU single market through the European Economic Area (EEA) instead.
Awards the Nobel Peace Prize in Oslo, per Alfred Nobel's will, giving it a distinct role in that global institution.
An active contributor to international peace mediation efforts and development aid, disproportionate to its small population size.

sections.heading: 🇮🇳 Relations with India
bullets: India and Norway cooperate closely on ocean/blue economy initiatives, renewable energy, and maritime technology through a dedicated bilateral Ocean Dialogue.
Norway's sovereign wealth fund is a significant portfolio investor in publicly listed Indian companies.
Growing collaboration on fisheries management, shipping, and green maritime technology, areas where Norway has world-leading expertise.

sections.heading: 📦 Trade & Economy
bullets: A wealthy economy built substantially on North Sea oil and natural gas exports, managed through the world's largest sovereign wealth fund.
A major global exporter of seafood (particularly salmon) and maritime/shipping services.
Increasingly investing oil-derived wealth into renewable energy and green shipping technology for long-term economic diversification.

sections.heading: ⭐ What It's Known For
bullets: Dramatic fjords and Viking heritage.
Managing the world's largest sovereign wealth fund, built from oil revenues.
Consistently ranking among the world's happiest and most gender-equal countries.
Awarding the Nobel Peace Prize in Oslo.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Norway is a wealthy Scandinavian parliamentary constitutional monarchy, a NATO founder but not an EU member, known for its fjords and the world's largest sovereign wealth fund.
keyFacts: Parliamentary constitutional monarchy; King ceremonial, Prime Minister governs.
Not an EU member (rejected membership twice); participates via the EEA instead.
Manages the world's largest sovereign wealth fund, built from oil and gas revenues.
commonConfusion: Norway is a NATO founding member but has never joined the European Union — it accesses the EU single market through the separate EEA agreement instead.

highYieldFacts: Norway: parliamentary constitutional monarchy; NATO founder; not an EU member (uses EEA).
Manages the world's largest sovereign wealth fund from oil/gas revenues.
India-Norway: Ocean Dialogue on blue economy; Norway's wealth fund invests significantly in Indian equities.
commonTraps: Assuming Norway is an EU member because it's a wealthy Western European nation — it is not.
Confusing Norway's Nobel Peace Prize role with Sweden hosting the other Nobel Prizes.
mustRemember: Norway: constitutional monarchy, NATO founder outside the EU, world's largest sovereign wealth fund, India ocean/blue-economy partner.
